summary: [standards] Round 2 also moved the L0.registry emitted-code, reason and warning conditions from documents_of_json_runs() to envelopes(), but no test notices: reverting that one line (registry judging every JSON document again) leaves the whole atip-check suite green, because no seeded case prints a non-envelope document that carries an error.code. Only the L0.contract-version half of finding 3 is pinned (atip_check_64). Behavior is as the author ruled (a non-envelope is L0.envelope's alone); the gap is a missing seed. Blast radius: a non-envelope document with an unregistered error code. Not blocking.
